Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 37, "heading": "CHAPTER 35. DEPRESSION", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u037-b0030", "target": "Слёзы радости катились у тётушки по щекам, право, и капали прямо в тёплый эль.", "source_sha256": "6a175b9ee6057ff87033a928308ada0fc8c3beeef7d1dcc9f7a1f2ca184d3ba7", "target_id": "ru-en85-u037-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4e3b0665b50769764db6a15e144c9238cffb0076d30b44adaf63d9448384f60b"}, {"source_id": "en85-u037-b0031", "target": "— Это самое нелепое создание, какое когда-либо рождалось, — сказала тётушка. — Я знала это с первой минуты, когда увидела её с твоей бедной милой благословенной матерью, этим дитятей. Что она самая нелепая из смертных. Но в Баркис есть и хорошие стороны!", "source_sha256": "46e12e2473951e22af6610dd2c65323478f1d4fa150495e22d07154d541e4896", "target_id": "ru-en85-u037-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c3a98189b7732d54395b02acad44b14645ff48b263d9839df8b41dc4bd259559"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 35, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u037-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Affecting to laugh, she got an opportunity of putting her hand to her eyes. Having availed herself of it, she resumed her toast and her discourse together.", "sha256": "1b3b42e45cdc23d2f0c0fb06cb5ffa785520aedece2e1585f55107195952069c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ah! Mercy upon us!’ sighed my aunt. ‘I know all about it, Trot! Barkis and myself had quite a gossip while you were out with Dick. I know all about it. I don’t know where these wretched girls expect to go to, for my part. I wonder they don’t knock out their brains against—against mantelpieces,’ said my aunt; an idea which was probably suggested to her by her contemplation of mine.", "sha256": "d2e3d9986563281ccd9680f2c59ec6680d6fb52908f94d75b335cfdeef0f36a7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Poor Emily!’ said I.", "sha256": "1150a2f6e5b1a34d478f76df7080877139a4fe1e2c1ed4bb8df91e1af9cf2625", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, don’t talk to me about poor,’ returned my aunt. ‘She should have thought of that, before she caused so much misery! Give me a kiss, Trot. I am sorry for your early experience.’", "sha256": "643cc985b8edee982cd88ffcf50a6e415cd2aa90fa6d7f3e02b215284644f52f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As I bent forward, she put her tumbler on my knee to detain me, and said:", "sha256": "194b920bc205b806a0db5d244920030fdd4ebdcc0c1945550839c339fb8888c4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, Trot, Trot! And so you fancy yourself in love! Do you?’", "sha256": "899d77ff70816a2cf96045f673ea89002ba9da37444cf26c2d13bccbbc8efcca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Fancy, aunt!’ I exclaimed, as red as I could be. ‘I adore her with my whole soul!’", "sha256": "5d9e7c454265fcc7b3e20dbdbd862d732ec39a9b0e8adf08bd2f588a59544abd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dora, indeed!’ returned my aunt. ‘And you mean to say the little thing is very fascinating, I suppose?’", "sha256": "4c60fd5c0aae7d3e5d814130d8f05b3a3c769b20c877a7b714e614ed22a1a8a5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear aunt,’ I replied, ‘no one can form the least idea what she is!’", "sha256": "3db857eae83611454f82c0be4aabdfc81c6c4d0ec76194d0a973987167dfeb23", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ah! And not silly?’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "33acecd5264ff67cb1800afe2453eaf627725852aa01dbb959147c19173306ce", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Silly, aunt!’", "sha256": "94f4369adb67c288e3ea01ac35c52af986a142187e7b2600c67880120a1521cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I seriously believe it had never once entered my head for a single moment, to consider whether she was or not. I resented the idea, of course; but I was in a manner struck by it, as a new one altogether.", "sha256": "eec7ce1abfb9e3c0dcabedb34754db10c90a7fcccaa9eae67c1cc5e8cef02f91", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not light-headed?’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "b3ee7fa26ba650297cb2ed406af1b8ed36b46629f2644566963123ad72c272b0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Light-headed, aunt!’ I could only repeat this daring speculation with the same kind of feeling with which I had repeated the preceding question.", "sha256": "091c97ddf2cd1cf3839b0e8280dd56ce369c9ec1eadffbe9658febdc5989835d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, well!’ said my aunt. ‘I only ask. I don’t depreciate her. Poor little couple! And so you think you were formed for one another, and are to go through a party-supper-table kind of life, like two pretty pieces of confectionery, do you, Trot?’", "sha256": "cb5f3259ea3d31be5b9eaa4c311dd3974e7b832066c6851496ac71db853bf34a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She asked me this so kindly, and with such a gentle air, half playful and half sorrowful, that I was quite touched.", "sha256": "fcff6be107e35380bcd21b9ff644c5b0a5860d288613fd44fb6784f2a5689cc0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘We are young and inexperienced, aunt, I know,’ I replied; ‘and I dare say we say and think a good deal that is rather foolish. But we love one another truly, I am sure. If I thought Dora could ever love anybody else, or cease to love me; or that I could ever love anybody else, or cease to love her; I don’t know what I should do—go out of my mind, I think!’", "sha256": "53eae4c55b32e21af473900e194441406a542027977971fa8ebdf3fffcaa49ea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ah, Trot!’ said my aunt, shaking her head, and smiling gravely; ‘blind, blind, blind!’", "sha256": "e43c0701c9053a52ffd736adf2a64304f73f23f3968ddb2762bd72e86ae27745", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Someone that I know, Trot,’ my aunt pursued, after a pause, ‘though of a very pliant disposition, has an earnestness of affection in him that reminds me of poor Baby. Earnestness is what that Somebody must look for, to sustain him and improve him, Trot. Deep, downright, faithful earnestness.’", "sha256": "446cce5a30904b0050bf67abc609f1e860ee9945da5b107063b080e2508c3b94", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If you only knew the earnestness of Dora, aunt!’ I cried.", "sha256": "afa26adb7bbd0b7325b3c7bf17c0953380fa36f4627346bae74314802c9f40e8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, Trot!’ she said again; ‘blind, blind!’ and without knowing why, I felt a vague unhappy loss or want of something overshadow me like a cloud.", "sha256": "72148d3450725099a88e926b3f8e05f547ff4eaf4babb58b659cbe8a1e10dcda", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘However,’ said my aunt, ‘I don’t want to put two young creatures out of conceit with themselves, or to make them unhappy; so, though it is a girl and boy attachment, and girl and boy attachments very often—mind! I don’t say always!—come to nothing, still we’ll be serious about it, and hope for a prosperous issue one of these days. There’s time enough for it to come to anything!’", "sha256": "20d43d39aaa29f7752dea58420b687868cb3e33a178fb30f999298e734e736c8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "This was not upon the whole very comforting to a rapturous lover; but I was glad to have my aunt in my confidence, and I was mindful of her being fatigued. So I thanked her ardently for this mark of her affection, and for all her other kindnesses towards me; and after a tender good night, she took her nightcap into my bedroom.", "sha256": "ad6289ff37ba0968b5dfe5ffa920829037ab11479f90715ec642c5f3da56e977", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "How miserable I was, when I lay down! How I thought and thought about my being poor, in Mr. Spenlow’s eyes; about my not being what I thought I was, when I proposed to Dora; about the chivalrous necessity of telling Dora what my worldly condition was, and releasing her from her engagement if she thought fit; about how I should contrive to live, during the long term of my articles, when I was earning nothing; about doing something to assist my aunt, and seeing no way of doing anything; about coming down to have no money in my pocket, and to wear a shabby coat, and to be able to carry Dora no little presents, and to ride no gallant greys, and to show myself in no agreeable light! Sordid and selfish as I knew it was, and as I tortured myself by knowing that it was, to let my mind run on my own distress so much, I was so devoted to Dora that I could not help it. I knew that it was base in me not to think more of my aunt, and less of myself; but, so far, selfishness was inseparable from Dora, and I could not put Dora on one side for any mortal creature. How exceedingly miserable I was, that night!", "sha256": "5b33a99ad459c5fd582510bff8ba7bb2d84809c85963a290be69de0b94236ea3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As to sleep, I had dreams of poverty in all sorts of shapes, but I seemed to dream without the previous ceremony of going to sleep. Now I was ragged, wanting to sell Dora matches, six bundles for a halfpenny; now I was at the office in a nightgown and boots, remonstrated with by Mr. Spenlow on appearing before the clients in that airy attire; now I was hungrily picking up the crumbs that fell from old Tiffey’s daily biscuit, regularly eaten when St. Paul’s struck one; now I was hopelessly endeavouring to get a licence to marry Dora, having nothing but one of Uriah Heep’s gloves to offer in exchange, which the whole Commons rejected; and still, more or less conscious of my own room, I was always tossing about like a distressed ship in a sea of bed-clothes.", "sha256": "6836fc926ace046204e40233c9d8849ebea3b96d9cbe2bf7b46f484a3a323566", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My aunt was restless, too, for I frequently heard her walking to and fro. Two or three times in the course of the night, attired in a long flannel wrapper in which she looked seven feet high, she appeared, like a disturbed ghost, in my room, and came to the side of the sofa on which I lay. On the first occasion I started up in alarm, to learn that she inferred from a particular light in the sky, that Westminster Abbey was on fire; and to be consulted in reference to the probability of its igniting Buckingham Street, in case the wind changed. Lying still, after that, I found that she sat down near me, whispering to herself ‘Poor boy!’ And then it made me twenty times more wretched, to know how unselfishly mindful she was of me, and how selfishly mindful I was of myself.", "sha256": "4c5b32bfd618cec78819c2e42f970c9f16d5ef7ddae62914ad1403a32964982a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was difficult to believe that a night so long to me, could be short to anybody else. This consideration set me thinking and thinking of an imaginary party where people were dancing the hours away, until that became a dream too, and I heard the music incessantly playing one tune, and saw Dora incessantly dancing one dance, without taking the least notice of me. The man who had been playing the harp all night, was trying in vain to cover it with an ordinary-sized nightcap, when I awoke; or I should rather say, when I left off trying to go to sleep, and saw the sun shining in through the window at last.", "sha256": "8c8d1bea486162b3f7a584595c09f83f7932c1e7f8f904a7e0891ca5454a2ab9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "There was an old Roman bath in those days at the bottom of one of the streets out of the Strand—it may be there still—in which I have had many a cold plunge. Dressing myself as quietly as I could, and leaving Peggotty to look after my aunt, I tumbled head foremost into it, and then went for a walk to Hampstead. I had a hope that this brisk treatment might freshen my wits a little; and I think it did them good, for I soon came to the conclusion that the first step I ought to take was, to try if my articles could be cancelled and the premium recovered. I got some breakfast on the Heath, and walked back to Doctors’ Commons, along the watered roads and through a pleasant smell of summer flowers, growing in gardens and carried into town on hucksters’ heads, intent on this first effort to meet our altered circumstances.", "sha256": "242aad6116c00596437f908d93e4ae53787a4ebaf999f47f85baac6e60399be8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I arrived at the office so soon, after all, that I had half an hour’s loitering about the Commons, before old Tiffey, who was always first, appeared with his key. Then I sat down in my shady corner, looking up at the sunlight on the opposite chimney-pots, and thinking about Dora; until Mr. Spenlow came in, crisp and curly.", "sha256": "f7f2bead1a3e79861b61a5a111c975111011116fc374cc22f18684080a46262c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘How are you, Copperfield?’ said he. ‘Fine morning!’", "sha256": "b6cf06ccdbf0fe65fdf4d19a47ab3a077c30ce49368c089ec5cc5e874adb8445", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Beautiful morning, sir,’ said I. ‘Could I say a word to you before you go into Court?’", "sha256": "7c638dee5fb8de3fa489fb704bc9eff6855c2dc01e054114942b571868a806f6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u037-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘By all means,’ said he. ‘Come into my room.’", "sha256": "041a20cca48cbedd2c42aab3f527a27202bdc8507b96fd1c3c8e8bb1126fc141", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
